Keys.Description: Discover keys, manage loaded private keys, and review process approvals.
Keys.DiscoveryCanceled: Discovery canceled. The previous result was kept.
Keys.DiscoveryCancelRetry: Could not cancel discovery yet. Try again.
Keys.ChooseVaults: Select vaults on the 1Password page before discovering SSH keys.
Keys.NoCache: Private key caching is off. The agent reads a private key temporarily when signing.
Keys.NoneFound: No SSH keys were found in the selected vaults.
Keys.BeforeDiscovery: Run Discover SSH keys to build the key list.
Keys.PreloadPartial: Some private keys could not load. Check each failed key.
Keys.AccessDenied: 1Password denied the private key request. Authorize a new request and retry.
Keys.ProviderBusy: 1Password is still processing a request. Wait and retry.
Keys.PrivateMissing: The private key is missing or unavailable. Check the item in 1Password.
Keys.PrivateInvalid: The private key returned by 1Password is invalid.
Keys.PrivateLookup: Could not read the private key. Check 1Password access and the item, then retry.
Keys.IndexChanged: The key list changed. Retry using the current list.
Keys.NoGrants: This key has no process approvals.
